```{r}
#| include: false
source("scripts/tbl/Calculation.classical.comparison.R")
CAP.INPUTS <- readCaption("tbl.Calculation.classical.inputs.ES")
CAP.SECTIONS <- readCaption("tbl.Calculation.classical.sections.ES")
CAP.STEEL <- readCaption("tbl.Calculation.classical.steel.ES")
CAP.SC100 <- readCaption("tbl.Calculation.classical.shotcrete100.ES")
CAP.SC150 <- readCaption("tbl.Calculation.classical.shotcrete150.ES")
CAP.NUNEZ <- readCaption("tbl.Calculation.classical.nunez.ES")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-calculation-classical-inputs
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP.INPUTS
#| echo: false
buildCalculationClassicalInputsTable(Calculation$classicalComparison$inputs)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-calculation-classical-sections
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP.SECTIONS
#| echo: false
buildCalculationClassicalSectionsTable(Calculation$classicalComparison$sections)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-calculation-classical-steel
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP.STEEL
#| echo: false
buildCalculationClassicalSummaryTable(Calculation$classicalComparison$summary, "steel")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-calculation-classical-shotcrete-100
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP.SC100
#| echo: false
buildCalculationClassicalSummaryTable(Calculation$classicalComparison$summary, "shotcrete")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-calculation-classical-shotcrete-150
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP.SC150
#| echo: false
buildCalculationClassicalSummaryTable(Calculation$classicalComparison$summary, "reinforcedConcrete")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-calculation-classical-nunez
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP.NUNEZ
#| echo: false
buildCalculationClassicalPointsTable(Calculation$classicalComparison$points)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(
  CAP.INPUTS, CAP.SECTIONS, CAP.STEEL, CAP.SC100, CAP.SC150, CAP.NUNEZ,
  buildCalculationClassicalInputsTable, buildCalculationClassicalSectionsTable,
  buildCalculationClassicalSummaryTable,
  buildCalculationClassicalPointsTable, .classicalDash,
  .classicalLiningLabel, .classicalMethodLabel,
  .classicalMethodCode, .classicalCaseCode
)
```
